selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the original curl version, persistent yum exclusion, effective parsed exclusion, and unchanged curl-7.29.0-59.el7.x86_64 after reboot.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 904172e0-7b6a-47b5-9c6a-1032302c4517, and recovered curl configuration and package health.
